positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsKeptAsset
positions.frame: what distinguishes owned intelligence from rented, and what is the asset worth keeping versus the commodity substrate it runs on?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional move — a categorical, unhedged opposition (conviction reads both as 'principle', not hedged notion) rendered as a plain-spoken aphoristic maxim (register mint AphoristicTechnicalMaxim; style mint RuleAsMatchedOpposition, matched clauses in deliberate antithesis) that frames intelligence/perspective in market terms (relational: market-pricing) and appeals to autonomy and self-possession (value: autonomy, self-enhancement) with calm, settled conviction (affect: calm-positive). src-2 sets owned against rented; src-3 sets commodity substrate against kept-asset perspective — the same opposition restated at a different grain, so the two cohere as one directional read rather than two separate claims. No tension: both sides of each antithesis and both expressions pull the same way.
